text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that's a shame. These things are
really
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no need to apologize! It really
means a lot
to me that you tried to get
them for my sisters. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't feel bad, Trainer! Just think of it
as an
offering to the claw machine!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Luck always comes around full circle!
Today, you donated a little luck to the
world. It's bound to
come back to you
sooner or later! ☆
